title: Repaired valid Read File Record
purpose: Exercise function 0x14 with one minimal valid file-record subrequest and internally consistent byte-count and MBAP length fields.
expected_behavior: Server should parse a valid function 0x14 request with byte count 0x07 and one file-record subrequest, then return file-record data or a standard exception.
constraints_preserved: MBAP header is present and complete.
length is 0x000a, matching unit_id plus 9-byte PDU.
Function code 0x14 is used for Read File Record.
Request contains a byte count field 0x07 followed by exactly one 7-byte file-record subrequest.
Subrequest preserves reference type 0x06, file number, record number, and record length fields in big-endian order.
issue_safety_notes: Repaired to remove prior count and length inconsistencies. It is a valid structural seed rather than a malformed boundary test.
